$comment: MF-37 admin media library contract (Spec 126 section 6.5, Spec 114 section 6 dated notes 2026-11-09; plan ~/Buildo-scratch/mcfrontend/MF-37/plan.v3.md section 3.2). One private bucket; one object per media_assets row at path_template; limits name logic_variables keys (values live in the table); request_schema is the POST /api/admin/media body in MF-42's keyword subset (no format, no conditionals) and the route builds its validator from it with z.fromJSONSchema, then applies kinds[kind].requires and the strict data-URL decode with magic bytes. scenario_key enum = the keys of report-v2-seed/row-presentation.json (T2 join lock). Read by src/lib/media/contract.ts; locked by src/tests/media-contract.logic.test.ts.

request_schema.$comment: The POST body. file is a data URL (RJSF FileWidget stores data:<mime>;name=<enc>;base64,<data>); the pattern only gates the MIME prefix, the server decode enforces the rest.

delete_schema.$comment: The DELETE /api/admin/media/<asset_id> body, validated as {asset_id: <path param>, confirm: <body.confirm>}; confirm must equal the row alt (checked under FOR UPDATE in the route).
